chaplain.name: Rev. Canon Oluwajuwonlo Onasanya
chaplain.title: University Chaplain
chaplain.bio: An Anglican Priest, University Administrator, Public Health Specialist and Lecturer with years of experience in higher education, pastoral ministry, health promotion, and community development.
biography: Rev. Canon Oluwajuwonlo Onasanya, is an Anglican Priest, a University Administrator, Public Health Specialist and a Lecturer with years of experience in higher education, pastoral ministry, health promotion, and community development, actively involved in Christian ministry, hosting conferences, growth meetings, and spiritual care programs.

He currently serves as the University Chaplain at Chrisland University, Abeokuta, where he leads an interdenominational Christian community focused on raising godly morals and instilling spiritual values. There, he provides strategic leadership in student development, counselling, ethical formation, and chaplaincy services.

Rev. Canon Onasanya holds a Bachelor of Science Degree in Microbiology from Bowen University, Master of Public Health Degree in Health Promotion and Education from Babcock University and a Master of Divinity from the Crowther Graduate Theological Seminary.

He lectures at various Higher Institutions of Learning, a researcher and passionate advocate for holistic wellbeing. His interests span public health promotion, leadership development, faith-based interventions, and student mentorship.

Beyond his ministerial calling, he is a public speaker, a public health practitioner, specializing in Health Promotion and Education and committed to integrating academic excellence, public health practice, and transformational leadership to foster healthier communities and ethically grounded institutions.

conclusion.quote: Sharing the core values of Chrisland University Chapel means more than preaching or organising programmes; it is about living out the message of Christ daily and encouraging others to do the same. Through the commitment to raising godly morals and instilling spiritual values, the Chapel remains a beacon of hope and a catalyst for change in the lives of students, shaping them into leaders who fear God, serve humanity, and transform the world.
conclusion.by: Rev. Canon Oluwajuwonlo Onasanya, University Chaplain
